integrity: Proof and executable reproducibility checks supplied; self-review only, without external independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the 0-Hecke monoid, not the corresponding algebra, and ordered pairs, not triples. Type-A counts and the integer recurrence were already known; only the Coxeter-general criterion and tree-shape invariance are assessed as a new contribution. The result does not establish absolute bibliographic priority. The finite verification is not an infinite proof.
title: Type-independent commuting-idempotent counts in finite Coxeter zero-Hecke monoids
